artifact:
/* Finite State Machine for Logging Requirements (U21_Logging) */

States:
  1. IDLE
  2. RECORDING
  3. COMPLETED

Events:
  - CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS
  - CHANGE_RTC
  - REQUEST_LOG
  - MEMORY_FULL

Transitions:
  - IDLE → RECORDING
    Guard: CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS (True)
  - RECORDING → COMPLETED
    Guard: (All ventilation settings confirmed) AND (Date & Timestamp recorded) AND (RTC change logged) (True)
  - COMPLETED → IDLE
    Guard: REQUEST_LOG (True)
  - RECORDING → IDLE
    Guard: MEMORY_FULL (False)

Actions:
  - In RECORDING state:
    - Log confirmed ventilation settings
    - Record current date and timestamp
    - Log changes to the system's real-time clock (Current Date/Time followed by new Date/Time)

test_cases.title: Confirm ventilation settings and log event
steps: Trigger CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS event
System transitions to RECORDING state
Log confirmed ventilation settings to non-volatile memory
expected: Event log contains confirmed ventilation settings

test_cases.title: Record date and timestamp in the event log
steps: Trigger REQUEST_LOG event
System transitions to COMPLETED state
Record current date and timestamp in the event log
expected: Event log includes a date and timestamp

test_cases.title: Log changes to the system's real-time clock
steps: Trigger CHANGE_RTC event
System logs Current Date/Time followed by new Date/Time in the event log
expected: Event log includes changes to the system's real-time clock

test_cases.title: Negative path: Attempt to log when memory is full
steps: Trigger CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS event
System checks MEMORY_FULL guard (False)
System transitions to IDLE state without logging
expected: No new log entry is created; system remains in IDLE state

test_cases.title: Boundary value: Log at the earliest possible timestamp
steps: Trigger REQUEST_LOG event at earliest possible timestamp
System records date and timestamp in the event log
expected: Event log includes the earliest possible date and timestamp

test_cases.title: Boundary value: Log at the latest possible timestamp
steps: Trigger REQUEST_LOG event at latest possible timestamp
System records date and timestamp in the event log
expected: Event log includes the latest possible date and timestamp
